summary.text: John Bradley is an independent write-in candidate for the Tennessee House of Representatives, District 93, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He also sought the Democratic nomination for the Shelby County Board of Commissioners, District 10, in the May 5, 2026 primary.

paragraphs.text: John Bradley lost the May 5, 2026 Democratic primary for the Shelby County Board of Commissioners, District 10, won by Lashanta Rudd.

According to Ballotpedia's quotation of his campaign website, his priorities included reducing blight, expanding affordable housing, fully funding Pre-K, supporting small businesses and union labor, and supporting Regional One Health.
